notes.title: Hotfix Notes 1/19/2018
notes.notes:
Announcements
-Issues with audio and video options spontaneously resetting have been fixed, but will require players to set their preferred settings upon loading this version.

Balance Changes
-No balance changes for this release.

Fixed Bugs
-The End Turn button now allows player to exit Darius's initial Out-Of-Turn activation when all his Half-Jacks are already in play.
-Pressing Enter to execute an action no longer ends the unit's activation early after using only hotkeys to selection actions.
-The Report Bugs button in the main menu now takes the player to the Steam Forums.
-The Objectives panel is now visible by default in single player missions instead of the action log.
-Mission 4 of Dark Seduction now has more clear objectives.
-Mission 6 now requires fewer Cygnar allies to survive to complete the mission.
-The game UI no longer appears over the Mission 2 ending motion comic.
-The Continuous Effects panel no longer appears over the panel showing the stats of a targeted unit.
-The Targeting panel now scales to smaller resolutions.
-The Action panel has been increased in size for readability.
-The Clean Up Dead Bodies option no longer causes Sprint to not grant extra movement.
-Execute button no longer spawns Alexia's Risen, preventing them from spawning in invalid locations.

Known Issues
-A small memory leak is present during matches. Should be fixed by next patch.
-A patrol of Cinerators in Mission 2 will not spawn if the player loads a save from the middle of the mission.
-Enemy Cinerators in Mission 7 may become stuck if the player runs their army to the mine when the Mission begins.
-Framerate may drop or hang during the AI turn on Single Player and Skirmish Matches with heavy troop numbers or systems with minimum required hardware.
-If you experience a crash, please email us with the circumstance of the crash, your dxdiag file, and your warmachinegame.log file.

notes.title: Release Notes 12/19/17 - Dark Seduction live!
notes.notes:
Dark Seduction is LIVE! Here are your release notes.


December 19 2017


Announcements
-Dark Seduction has arrived! The long awaited tale of Haley and Deneghra is now available!
-Captain Victoria Haley is now selectable for Multiplayer, Skirmish and Casual Quickmatch!
-UI has been greatly touched up and improved with more art and smoother usability.
-A New Action Camera now gives the player a cinematic, over-the-shoulder view when using ranged attacks and spells!
-Issues with audio and video options spontaneously resetting have been fixed, but will require players to set their preferred settings upon loading this version.
-All DLC is now rolled into the base game.
-Game is incompatible with latest Mac OS update High Sierra and we will be discontinuing Mac support after this patch. Game will still run on Sierra OS.


Balance Changes
-No balance changes for this release.


Fixed Bugs
-Fixed an issue where pressing the Escape key in the Squad Constructor could cause the game to crash.
-The Enter key will now execute any pending action and confirm focus allocation.
-Units will no longer play weapon swings and holster animations at the wrong times.
-Units now enter a melee-ready stance when targeted by ranged attacks.
-Units no longer do idle 'fidget' animations when in melee or targeted by abilities.
-Stormcallers now properly aim at targets.
-A number of abilities now have proper 'preparing' and 'executing' animations.
-Using assault on a diagonal path to a target no longer prevents the melee attack half of the assault to trigger. 
-Magnus's Foecleaver now properly auto-boosts damage.
-Alexia's Death Magic abilities have more detailed tooltips.
-Alexia's Craft Thrall now places the Thrall Warrior in the same square as the Risen it replaces, preventing Thralls from being placed on top of other units.
-Fixed an issue where the game could become stuck after a client player used Alexia's Craft Thrall.
-Daughters of the Flame should no longer get 3 attacks.
-Godhead no longer damages units using the teleport spell to move.
-Flashbang no longer affects warjacks.
-Fixed an issue where Mage Sight would not remove stealth in some instances.
-Fixed an issue where the admonition spell could place units inside the same square as another unit.
-Restored the Iron Fang's Dash ability.
-Removed the unusable "Drive: Boosted Attack" from the Man-O-Kovnik.
-Spells should no longer be able to target destructible objects.
-A warjack's model will now properly despawn if killed while knocked down.
-Players can no longer interact with the map or UI directly behind the "Are You Sure" dialogue boxes, such as accidently placing a new movement destination while trying to confirm a run.
-Restored and updated hotkeys, and all action buttons have their assigned hotkey visible on the button icon.
-Players can once again left click and right click directly on warjacks to allocate and remove focus.
-Updated the spell icons with an additional symbol to identify upkeep spells.
-Made action category buttons darker when they contain no accessible actions.
-Abilities that cost focus now have a blue focus symbol on their icon in the action bar.
-There is now a separate window attached to the unit card that shows active effects, which can be dismissed and restored.
-Fixed issue where the unit card would not be dismissed after deselecting a unit.
-Spells that do not inflict damage no longer have an unnecessary boost damage panel players can put focus into.
-Spells now specify in their description if they are offensive or defensive.
-Fixed an issue where Lines drawn to targets in range would not always draw to all valid targets.
-Fixed an issue where the UI would not grey out during an action or ability in high lag environments.
-Fixed issues where the focus allocation screen would not scale correctly in different resolutions and different numbers of warjacks and upkeep effects.
-The Combat Log and Objectives windows are now larger and entries should no longer appear cut-off in some situations.
-Fixed issues in the Tutorial where the player could cancel sprint movement and allocate incorrect amounts of focus, which would block progression.
-Fixed an issue where canceling the first movement of the tutorial would prevent you from moving at all and blocking progression.
-Fixed an issue in Tutorial where ending turn too early would prevent progression through the tutorial.
-Added additional safeguards to prevent matchmaking from failing to connect to players after multiple sessions.
-Players can once again select to move a unit immediately after selecting them.
-Tutorial Prompts are now less persistent, such as giving a prompt about an enemy warcaster's feat when they appear briefly in single player missions.
-Fixed an issue where some character voices were not being affected by the Voice Volume audio setting.
-Players can now use Shift+Tab to go to the previous selection or unit.
-Unit cards can now be hidden by pressing the I key.
-Combat Log can now be toggled with the L key.
-Added definition for the term "Battlegroup" to the glossary.
-Fixed an issue where all defeated units would not always appear correctly at the end of a Single Player Mission.
-Fixed Warjack names not always being capitalized in the focus allocation screen.
-Pressing Tab no longer causes dotted lines to cycle through the squad list.
-The Toolbox now includes options to activate the Measuring Tool and the Chat Box.
-Fixed a number of instances where the Chat Box would not appear or dismiss properly.
-Fixed an issue where a white box would appear in place of a character's portrait during certain actions.
-The Fullscreen option no longer resets to Windowed Fullscreen after leaving the options menu.
-Auto Determine and Reset Defaults graphics options are now confirmed by pressing "Apply Changes"
-Changes to options are now canceled by backing out of the options menu.
-Fixed issues where audio and video settings could spontaneously reset.


Known Issues
-Enemy Cinerators in Mission 7 may become stuck if the player runs their army to the mine when the Mission begins.
-Framerate may drop or hang during the AI turn on Single Player and Skirmish Matches with heavy troop numbers or systems with minimum required hardware.
-If you experience a crash, please email us with the circumstance of the crash, your dxdiag file, and your warmachinegame.log file.
-Please check our Known Issues Mega List in the Bug Reports page on our forums for a full list of Known Issues.

notes.title: Save/Load Hotfix Patch!
notes.notes:
Sorry for the late announcement, if you didn't catch it, patch went live last week! Here are your notes:

22 September 2016

Announcements
-Single-player and Skirmish matches can now be saved and loaded!
-A warcaster's control range indicator now updates its position when a player is planning a move, allowing the player to preview its range before executing the move.
Balance Changes
-DoomReaver health reduced from 15 health to 13 health.

Fixed Bugs 
-Subtitles should now be visible on the map screen between single player missions
-Measuring tool no longer requires tons of mouse clicks to use.
-Alexia's Raise Dead, Boost Damage and Boost Attack abilities no longer considered spells and should not be blocked by abilities that prevent spell casting.
-Depth of Field setting has been fully removed to prevent excessive blur on lights.
-Fixed an issue where the game could get stuck if Karchev's Ground Zero tried to push a unit with no room to move.
-Explosivo can no longer be used with Combined Ranged Attacks.
-Critical Freeze now properly applies the frozen visual effect.
-Critical Shred and sustained attack now work properly when both are applied.
-Units immune to magic can no longer be affected by spells via dispersal from a nearby valid spell target.
-Tutorial updated with more visual cues to indicate where the player should go to activate bandit.
-The Long Gunner's Dual Shot no longer works when a unit stands up from a knockdown.
-Grab and Smash only activate off initial melee attacks.
-Description for Soulless Escort Mage Static ability updated for better clarity.
-Achievement "Bottled Lightning" removed and no longer required for 100% achievement.
-Units with Out-of-Turn activations now have a more noticeable VFX to identify themselves.
-User settings should no longer reset upon relaunching the game.
-Critical Smite will now trigger from a weapon's other attacks as well as its basic attack.
-Critical Smite now correctly appears on Rahn and Siege's unit cards.
-Force Lock will no longer allow a charge attack's melee attack to be diverted to a new target.
-Impending Doom now pulls units in automatically.
-Polarity Shield now correctly makes the affected unit untargetable by slams.
-Set Defense now correctly grants +1 Defense against charge attacks.
-Renegade no longer requires 2 focus to charge.
-Choir Hymns now list a range (RNG 3).
-Spell Warded units are now correctly affected by AoE spells.
-Long Gunner can no longer perform Dual Shot or Suppressive Fire after standing up.
-Hydra's Grab and Smash now only triggers from initial attacks.
-Lighting updated on all maps.

Known Issues
-Lines drawn to targets in range are sometimes not drawn to all valid targets.
-The Free Strike Warning message may appear randomly if you cancel a movement that would incur a free strike and move a different unit.
-A warjack's model may not despawn if killed while knocked down.
-The Targeting panel of Siege's Ground Pounder ability does not allow the player to boost the ability, but it can still be boosted with hot keys.
-Enemy Cinerators in Mission 7 may become stuck if the player runs their army to the mine when the Mission begins.
-Framerate may drop or hang during the AI turn on Single Player and Skirmish Matches with heavy troop numbers or systems with minimum required hardware.
-Rare crash may occur on certain GPU/hardware configurations.
-There are currently no Hotkey settings in the Options Menu. Keybindings can still be set in the in-game options menu.
-If you experience a crash, please email us with the circumstance of the crash, your dxdiag file, and your warmachinegame.log file.
-Please check our Known Issues Mega List in the Bug Reports page on our forums for a full list of Known Issues.

notes.title: October Patch Update 10/15
notes.notes:
BEHOLD OUR LARGEST PATCH EVER, IS NOW LIVE!

October 29, 2015


Announcements
-Warmachine: Tactics is now updated to Unreal Engine 4.9, bringing signifigant performance improvements!
-Check out all the latest news about Warmachine: Tactics on the new splash screen!
-Introducing a new measuring tool to accurately determine distance and line of sight between locations and units!
-Scenario Flags now have new art that reflects which player has control of the zone.
-Retribution Myrmidon Chimera is now available to the Retribution of Scyrah faction!
-Retribution warriors Houseguard Halberdiers are now available to the Retribution of Scyrah faction!
-Destroyed Warjacks now leave wreck markers that act as rough terrain and grant cover.
-Custom Squads can now be given descriptions.
-New Visual Effects for Feats and signature spells!
-All units have been given new Halloween Hats! (You can turn them off in the graphics options)

Balance Changes
-Pikehedge updated to make melee attacks on any enemy that runs or charges into a Steelhead Halberdier's melee range.
-Winterguard Aim Low ability now reduces target's speed by -1 instead of -2.
-Kell Bailoch's Crippling Shot now reduces a target's speed by -1 instead of -3.
-Repenter Flamethrower range increased to 10 from 8.
-Flameguard Cleanser Health dropped to 10.
-Temple Flameguard Health increased to 12.
-Steelhead Halberdier Health dropped to 9.
-Battle Mage point cost dropped to 3.
-Battle Mage Health dropped to 7.
-Units with Shield Wall may now make a normal attack after entering Shield Wall.

Fixed Bugs
-Warjacks in Terminus' battle group should no longer receive tough.
-Godhead should no longer trigger Enliven.
-Godhead no longer triggers on enemies who freestrike.
-Warcasters can no longer use Heal Self after teleporting.
-Fixed the wording of Menoth's Howl.
-Fixed the wording of Kinetic Whirlwind.
-Fixed the Godhead tooltip to display the correct 8 damage.
-Martyrdom will not be active on units that have gone beyond 10 squares.
-Skirmish and Single Player AI should no longer skip their turn when using multi-attack abilities like Thunder Thrust and Assault.
-Allison will no longer charge twice in tutorial.
-Wildfire no longer allows more than 3 focus allocated per jack.
-Using Terminus and Deathjack will no longer causes fatal errors.
-Terminus should no longer get stuck on top of his units.
-Fixed a rare issue where Mission 16 could not be completed.
-Mangler's Thresher attack now benefits from boosted attack rolls when under Magnus' Iron Aggression.
-Feora's WildFire feat no longer allows more than 3 focus to be allocated to warjacks.

Known Issues
-Continuous Fire and Continuous Corrosion can sometimes trigger twice when the effect expires.
-Units sometimes will show incorrect facing after moving diagonally or hit with a Free Strike.
-Enemy Cinerators in Mission 7 may become stuck if the player runs their army to the mine when the Mission begins.
-Framerate may drop or hang during the AI turn on Single Player and Skirmish Matches with heavy troop numbers or systems with minimum required hardware.
-The Achievements 'Multi-Talented' , 'Bigger is Better' and 'Battle Mage' are not unlocking correctly.
-An AI Controlled Darius may skip his activation if his Halfjacks are all engaged.
-Sometimes Right Mouse Button will not move units (Left-Mouse button will still work)

Crashes
-Rare crash may occur on certain GPU/hardware configurations.
-If you experience a crash, please email us with the circumstance of the crash, your dxdiag file, and your warmachinegame.log file.

Unimplemented
-Unit painter.
-Asynchronous Play.

Events
-Join our #WTFridays developer stream on Twitch every second and fourth Friday! 
-New to the game? Our community is here to teach you! Visit the forum thread at forums.whitemoondreams.com/showthread.php?1925-Hey-community-chime-in-if-you-are-willing-to-teach-new-players-the-game
-Got an itch for competitive play? Check out our forums for upcoming tournaments: forums.whitemoondreams.com/forumdisplay.php?16-Tournaments
-Vote on which new features and units you want to see next on our Trello boards! trello.com/b/32ZRQmwv/warmachine-tactics
-Like our game? Please leave us a review on Steam and let us know what you think! steamcommunity.com/app/253510/reviews/

notes.title: Patch Updates Galore! 7/14-8/19
notes.notes:
July 14th, 2015

Announcements:

-A new damage system has been implemented! See balance changes for details!
-New art for the Action Panel!
-Miniature version of unit cards now appear when targeting enemies or allies.
-In a multiplayer game, the second player is now able to view the first player's deployment as it happens.
-On-screen indicators now indicate when control zones and flags activate on scenario maps.
-Control point score indicator now indicates the point threshold required to win the match.
-A fix is now included for the infamous Stuck Activation Bug!
-Apotheosis Warcasters Coming Next Update!
-We continue to improve performance issues.

Balance Changes
-A new damage system has been implemented! All unit attacks now do base damage + a random +1, -1 or 0. Base damage has also been universally increased across all units.
-Critical hits now do guaranteed max possible damage, instead of extra damage.
-Warcaster 'Heal Self' ability now heals 2 Hit-Points for each focus spent.
-All Warcasters and Warriors have increased health.

The player cannot end the Trencher's activation while targeting with the Smoke Grenade.

Units sometimes will show incorrect facing after moving diagonally or being hit with a Free Strike.

Warjacks will sometimes not play all their attack animations when performing multiple attacks.

Putting focus into Stationary Units will remove the Frozen visual effect, even if the Stationary Effect is not yet shaken.

Special Icons indicating free strikes or control area will not appear when selecting a destination for the Run action.

Units will appear to sink into either platform in the Forest Ruins map when standing on certain squares.

Units can move through the stone blocks near each deployment zone.

Cloud Effects, such as Smoke Grenades, do not block Line of Sight.

Slamming a model into another model does not cause collateral damage or knockdown to the second model.


Not Yet Implemented:

Deneghra's Cull Soul Feature

Combined Attacks

Warjack Power Attacks: Throw and Two-Handed Throw

Custom Squad Construction

NEW MAP!
TRENCHES AT THE BORDER

See images on our website here!

Amidst the crumbling walls of a forgotten fortress that once held the Northern border of Cgynar, battle rages today just as it has for a thousand years before. Blood-soaked ground, carved deep with earthwork defenses provide limited protection against an onslaught of enemies advancing behind the cover of the ancient ruins at the forest’s edge.

Take your ground and give no quarter as you charge across this killing field to meet your opponent. Victory belongs to the greatest tactician, a title to be decided at the Trenches at the Border!

-       Sorscha immune to Icy Gaze and Freezing Grip
-       Deneghra’s Influence added
-       More UI getting cleaned up/added
-       And more!

Remember – your feedback is making this game better and better!

Thank you for all your continued support and we’ll see you on our brand-new daytime battlefield!
